Subject: Claim Decision Regarding {CLAIM_NUMBER}

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim regarding the collision that occurred on 2026-04-12. We are pleased to inform you that your claim, {CLAIM_NUMBER}, has been approved.

The loss is covered under your collision coverage. Specifically, your policy states: "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, minus the collision deductible shown in the Declarations."

The net payment to you is {PAYOUT}, and the deductible of {DEDUCTIBLE} has already been subtracted from this amount.

As a next step, payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued within 5 business days.

If you have any questions regarding this decision, please contact us directly.

Sincerely,

ClaimPilot Claims Team
